verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair openness question for a SaaS spend-management platform, but the evidence shows Ramp only as a vendor-hosted service. The open-source CLI and the locally run MCP server (ramp-mcp, an ETL plus in-memory sqlite) are client-side tools that call Ramp's hosted API, not a self-hostable deployment of the core product, so they earn no credit.
